## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Remote relay advertising + heartbeat attention status (cli, ~0h, SKIP)

- **What**: Kilocode #12532 fixes two issues: enabling the remote relay from
  the TUI `/remote` slash command connected the socket and mirrored sessions
  but never advertised the instance, so the CLI never appeared as a spawn
  target in the mobile "Run on" picker (only explicit `kilo remote` command
  called setInstanceAdvertisement); the heartbeat built session status from
  SessionStatus.Service (idle/retry/busy/offline union) and never consulted
  Question.Service or Permission.Service, so sessions blocked on questions
  were advertised as busy and mobile app showed no needs-input badge. Fixes:
  advertisement runs on every successful enableRemote() entry before early
  returns (bootstrap auto-enable frequently connects first, so `/remote`
  usually hits `if (remote) return`); extract precedence (permission, then
  question, then SessionStatus) into shared helper used by both deriveStatus
  and heartbeat (permission and question lists fetched once per tick and
  indexed by session id); sharing also means SessionStatus offline now
  reports as retry on wire (matching deriveStatus).
- **Why**: Alexi has no remote relay, no mobile client, and no spawn-target
  advertising. SKIP (not applicable to single-machine CLI; Alexi has no
  equivalent of Kilo's remote relay or mobile "Run on" picker).
- **Source**: Kilo-Org/kilocode PR #12532 "Advertise the instance from
  enableRemote and report attention status on the heartbeat" (merged
  2026-07-26T05:23Z, commit `a7c9e3f`). Full PR body at
  https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/12532.
- **Category**: cli. **Size**: N/A (~0h if applicable: no remote relay to
  advertise, no mobile client to consume heartbeat). **Status**: SKIP (Alexi
  is single-machine CLI, no remote relay).

#### 2. OpenAI Compatible model ID stale/reset (provider, ~0h, SKIP)

- **What**: Cline #12552 fixes model ID under chat field going stale after
  Done when OpenAI Compatible provider selected. The settings provider
  dropdown sources ids from SDK catalog, so picking OpenAI Compatible stored
  'openai-compatible' into plan/actModeApiProvider. Every provider-keyed
  code path (webview model label, planModeOpenAiModelId slots, session
  factory) expects legacy 'openai' spelling, so model id fell back to
  catalog default (gpt-4o). Fixes: parseProviderId + toLegacyApiProvider
  alias openai-compatible -> openai, state-keys load transform migrates
  already-stored SDK spellings, convertProtoToApiProvider normalizes
  provider ids written from webview, commitModelSelection writes legacy
  spelling and posts state to webview (model-only commits refresh chat model
  label immediately), session factory normalizes provider ids from state and
  providers.json; toLegacyApiProvider lowercases for case-insensitive alias
  lookup; normalize both sides of provider comparisons in
  SdkProviderChangeCoordinator.providerForMode and
  SdkController.isSelectionForActiveModeProvider (spelling-only difference
  neither restarts active session nor skips lightweight in-session model
  update).
- **Why**: Alexi uses SAP AI Core (single provider via
  routing-config.json), not a multi-provider catalog with per-provider model
  dropdowns. SKIP (no equivalent of provider dropdown state management;
  Alexi has no SDK catalog, no settings provider dropdown, no legacy/SDK
  spelling migration).
- **Source**: Cline PR #12552 "fix(vscode): model ID under chat field stale
  / resets to gpt-4o for OpenAI Compatible" (merged 2026-07-26T04:51Z,
  commit `b8d2f1a`). Full PR body at
  https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/12552.
- **Category**: provider. **Size**: N/A (~0h if applicable: no multi-
  provider catalog, no settings dropdown). **Status**: SKIP (Alexi is
  single-provider SAP AI Core).

  function); VscodeWebviewProvider disposed whole Controller on WebviewView

  deactivation). Alexi is CLI-first (no VS Code webview lifecycle). Skip.
